title: Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work
hook_text: Thirty thousand Uber workers just got ChatGPT.
script:
Thirty thousand Uber employees just got full access to ChatGPT Work.
The ride share giant previously ran a much smaller pilot program for the enterprise agent.
Now OpenAI is scaling the enterprise tool company wide across the entire organization.
Every staff member gets direct daily access to enterprise grade AI assistance for their tasks.
This move signals a massive push by OpenAI to dominate corporate workflows at scale.
Would your employer roll out ChatGPT to everyone?
